0.description: Rarely buy, cash advances dominate, low credit limit, rarely pay full.
0.strategy: Risk containment, financial education, offer personal loans instead of cash advances.

1.description: Frequent small purchasers, avoid cash advances, often pay full, high credit limit.
1.strategy: Loyalty rewards, cashback, premium card upgrades, cross‑sell travel & insurance.

2.description: High cash advance AND many big purchases, moderate payment behaviour.
2.strategy: Balance transfer offers, instalment plans, monitor for delinquency.

3.description: Extremely active, both small and large purchases, very few cash advances.
3.strategy: Premium cards, higher credit lines, concierge services, retention campaigns.

4.description: Infrequent but very large purchases, rarely use cash advances, high credit limit.
4.strategy: Encourage everyday use with bonus points, instalment options for large items.
